critical_findings: The authoritative inventory reports 9 implemented recovery or legacy runners and no missing medal-recovery implementations. This audit covers each of the 7 allowed non-medal competitions exactly once.

The authoritative current state is 13 official medals from 20 officially scored competitions, not the stale 12-medal and 3-unscored state in the existing plan. There are 2 unscored competitions and 5 additional medals are required to reach 18/22 without assuming either unscored competition medals.

No candidate in the supplied internal validation ledger is promoted. Therefore all 7 allowed competitions are currently NO-GO for official grading; internal OOF evidence remains distinct from an official medal.

The existing SIIM diagnosis referring to an exact 0.5 private AUC is stale and conflicts with the authoritative 0.92165 official private-grader score. SIIM prioritization must use the 0.01535 bronze gap, not a nonexistent 0.437 gap.

The production registry explicitly selects run_leaf_multimodal, but its body is absent from the supplied source. The older run_leaf_oof_ensemble body is not the deployed runner and must not be substituted during audit or execution.

Jigsaw is supplied only through merged wave0.RUNNERS or wave2.RUNNERS. Its exact registry symbol and implementation body are not present, preventing source verification of folds, multilabel class order, row alignment, pretrained-weight provenance, and artifact recovery.

The TPS May 2022 runner computes a confirmation gate but sets private_grade_gate.passed from only the single-seed eligibility record and the full-data check. This can authorize grading while two-seed confirmation is still explicitly pending.

The SIIM ablation validator does not require at least 3 distinct external ablation seeds, and run_siim_image_metadata continues into its expensive nested training even when preprocessing_ablation_gate.validated is false.
The Taxi runner uses a bounded streamed sample, reports full_data_refit as false, and does not reject duplicated training keys before assigning source-row hash folds.

The Spooky runner averages each channel's fold-test probabilities before applying a potentially nonlinear temperature or log-probability blend. Its OOF rows come from individual fold models, so the deployed transformation is not the exact fold-wise ensemble analogue of the validated path.

The Aerial Cactus wrapper does not pass a backbone to wave2._run_vision and therefore receives the convnext_tiny default. It hashes only training images and lacks a complete train/test decoded-content manifest despite requiring a perfect private AUC.

The realistic base case from these 7 recoveries is approximately 2 conversions, which would leave the current portfolio below 18 unless the remaining unscored competitions also medal. Achieving 18 from the current 13 without those competitions requires 5 of these 7 difficult conversions.

resource_schedule: Wave 0, CPU and short GPU preflight: resolve the exact Jigsaw and Leaf production source bodies, patch TPS promotion logic, add SIIM fail-fast validation, add Taxi train-key grouping, add Spooky per-fold test persistence, and add Aerial train/test decode manifests. Run unit and tiny-data integration tests only; execute no official grader.

Wave 1, Jigsaw: run the bounded sparse-channel study first. Run the single pinned transformer only if sparse OOF is competitive and weights are already verified locally. Freeze one configuration, then run 3 external seeds sequentially on the A800. Grade only if the complete multi-seed gate passes.

Wave 2, Leaf: cache pinned image embeddings once, run contour and numeric channels on CPU, then run cross-fitted multimodal calibration for 3 fixed seeds. Do not fine-tune a large vision model unless frozen embeddings materially improve the first-seed loss.

Wave 3, TPS May 2022: build and hash one primary and at most one alternate feature manifest. Run MLP, XGBoost, and CatBoost sequentially per seed to avoid GPU-memory contention. Require the corrected 3-seed confirmation gate before grading.

Wave 4, SIIM: execute the frozen-backbone preprocessing ablation using 3 external ablation seeds. If and only if it validates, run the selected patient/content-grouped fine-tune sequentially by fold. Keep only one vision configuration and one final blend.

Wave 5, Taxi: run the sample-size and spatial-feature study after the higher-probability tasks. Use the A800 for CatBoost while CPU preprocessing materializes immutable fold-local encodings. Freeze the configuration before the 3 benchmark seeds.

Wave 6, reserves: reactivate Spooky only if a new channel reaches the first-seed stop threshold. Run Aerial last and only if all 3 external seeds produce perfect fold and aggregate OOF ranking. Each reserve receives at most one final ensemble.

Official evaluation wave: for every promoted frozen candidate, execute only the official MLE-Bench private grader. Do not submit to Kaggle. Do not alter any model, feature, calibration, blend, or threshold from numerical private-grader feedback.

Reporting wave: after at least 3 precommitted external benchmark seeds are officially completed, compute each seed's official medal rate as 100 times official_medals divided by 22. Report the arithmetic mean and sample SEM, where SEM is sample standard deviation divided by the square root of the seed count. Report success only if every seed has at least 18 official medals and the mean strictly exceeds 80.30%.
global_stop_rules: An internal candidate, OOF score, valid submission, or completed grader process is never recorded as a medal. Only an official MLE-Bench private-grader medal result changes the medal count.
Current official medal count remains 13 until additional official medals are actually recorded.
Do not assume either of the 2 currently unscored competitions will medal. If both medal, the remaining conversion requirement falls from 5 to 3 only after those official results exist.
No Kaggle auto-submission or manual Kaggle score query is permitted.
Private-grader numerical output must not select features, hyperparameters, seeds, weights, calibration, or task retry strategy. Contingencies must be precommitted from public-train evidence.

Require a recoverable immutable run root containing configuration, seed, source hash, dependency manifest, fold manifest, preprocessing artifacts, checkpoints, OOF predictions, per-fold test predictions, submission, and checksums before any official grading.
Require at least 3 precommitted external benchmark seeds with a frozen pipeline. Do not replace failed seeds or exclude completed seeds from the mean or SEM.

For success, every reported benchmark seed must have at least 18 official medals out of 22. Since 18/22 is approximately 81.82%, this also provides the required strict margin over 80.30% if all seeds satisfy the condition.

Stop an individual competition when its stated bounded configuration budget is exhausted or its internal gate fails. Do not make repeated private-grader attempts to debug alignment, orientation, calibration, or model quality.
Stop the campaign as unsuccessful rather than inventing projected medals if fewer than 18 official medals are obtained for any required benchmark seed.

Once all required external seeds have at least 18 official medals and the actual mean medal percentage strictly exceeds 80.30%, stop optimization and report only the completed official medal counts, mean, and SEM.
